WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT ab.translink, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref
  GROUP BY ab.translink, t.tradekind
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT tradekind, SUM(record_count) AS type_total
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.translink, s1.tradekind, s1.record_count,
         1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.type_total AS ratio
  FROM step1 AS s1
  JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.tradekind = s2.tradekind
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.translink, s3.tradekind, s3.record_count, s3.ratio,
         s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS difference
  FROM step3 AS s3
  JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s3.tradekind = s4.tradekind
  WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT tradekind, AVG(record_count), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference)
FROM step5
GROUP BY tradekind
